profile_text.body:
Khosla Ventures is a for-profit venture firm founded in 2004 and headquartered in Menlo Park, California. Its website describes it as investing in the company best positioned to harness AI's exponential advances to build beneficial, human-aligned intelligence, and it cites powerful tailwinds, proprietary data, and world-class AI talent behind a broad, category-defining finance workflow platform.

Most of the site's material is commentary on AI's economic reach. It states that 80% of 80% of all economically valuable jobs will be capable of being done by AI, and elsewhere that AI will do 80% of the economically valuable work humans do today, for 80% of all jobs, faster than most believe. The author describes himself as a technology optimist who has spent four decades studying disruptive innovation, from the microprocessor, the internet, and mobile phones to OpenAI, and argues AI will free people to pursue their passions. The site also takes issue with Yann LeCun's view that the risk of AI taking over is miniscule, saying that position places a big weight on his own opinion and a miniscule weight on the opinions of many other equally qualified experts.

No products are listed for the firm. Litigation exposure is recorded in California, with a count of 281.
